methodology.displayName: Threshold Sign-On activation and collective-action model v1

estimandDefinitions.success_case_additional: Other qualifying participants or action units that become public or are completed if the frozen verified-human threshold is met, excluding the participant’s own signature or action.
estimandDefinitions.expected_additional: The modeled increase in exact-threshold activation probability caused by the participant’s qualifying signature multiplied by other qualifying participant or action units activated on success.
estimandDefinitions.direct_causal_attribution: Other verified qualifying participant or action units attributable to the participant under the approved signature-arrival and pivotality model, capped at the verified coalition outcome.
estimandDefinitions.verified_additional: Other qualifying participants or action units independently verified after atomic activation and any required post-activation completion step.
estimandDefinitions.cooperative_allocation: A non-additive Shapley allocation of the verified or expected coalition outcome across qualifying signers under the frozen threshold, eligibility, withdrawal, expiry, and action-completion rules.

methodology.baselineDefinition: Before the first qualifying signature, freeze the proposition, exact verified-human threshold, eligibility rule, deadline, withdrawal and expiry rules, risk acknowledgements, identity-reveal policy, required public act, and what each eligible participant would do without threshold activation. Pre-threshold identities remain private.
methodology.algorithmDescription: Estimate exact-threshold activation with and without the participant’s qualifying signature from resolved commitments matched on proposition class, threshold, deadline, eligible population, privacy, and risk class. Multiply the probability change by other qualifying participant or action units for expected additionality. After atomic activation, verify the exact signer set and any required action completion. Report direct pivotality and cooperative allocation separately, and withhold rather than model propositions whose risk or legality is outside the approved domain.

referenceClassPolicy.uncertaintyExpansionRule: Preserve risk class and required action while broadening. Add between-proposition and between-population variance at every step. Withhold if activation calibration or post-activation completion calibration is unavailable.

uncertaintyPolicy.method: Use a calibrated hierarchical event-time model for qualifying signature arrivals and withdrawals, a separate completion model for post-activation action, and seeded-permutation cooperative allocation with approximation error included.
uncertaintyPolicy.confidencePolicy: Withhold when model health is blocked or stale. Label low confidence only after health passes and the eligible sample is at least 50; moderate requires at least 100 eligible resolved observations, no more than one approved reference-class broadening step, and no blocking calibration failure; high requires at least 200 observations, the narrowest approved class, empirical 80% coverage between 75% and 85%, calibration slope between 0.8 and 1.2, and no active warnings.

requiredCalibrationMetrics: Brier score for modeled completion or activation probability
activation calibration by threshold and eligible-population band
blockedConditions: eligible resolved-observation count below the methodology minimum
80% interval empirical coverage outside the approved tolerance
required state is missing or does not match the immutable state hash
input is outside the approved domain
unresolved evidence-integrity, duplication, or overlap failure
credential or one-person-one-account integrity cannot be verified
proposition falls into a prohibited or unreviewed high-risk class
private signer manifest cannot be atomically validated
warningConditions: reference class broadened beyond the narrowest approved class
sample size below the high-confidence threshold
calibration drift within the warning band
material share of observations relies on participant attestation rather than independent evidence
small or highly selected eligible population
high-risk proposition with sparse resolved history
substantial withdrawal rate near the deadline

sourceDataRequirements: immutable proposition, threshold, eligibility, deadline, risk, reveal, withdrawal, and expiry terms
privacy-preserving qualifying-signer count and stable deduplication keys
current credential validity and duplicate-human rejection state
audited resolved Threshold Sign-On outcomes with privacy-preserving attributes
knownFailureModes: duplicate humans or stale credentials inflate apparent support
private signer count leaks identities before threshold
participants sign but do not complete the required public act
signers would have acted independently without threshold protection
high-risk participants face harms not represented in the outcome quantity
manifest or reveal race creates inconsistent signer sets
direct and cooperative attribution are summed
outOfDomainConditions: illegal, violent, deceptive, harassing, coercive, or otherwise prohibited proposition
proposition requires professional legal or safety judgment not encoded in an approved risk policy
eligibility cannot be verified without storing prohibited identity data
required action is unobservable or cannot be bounded
identity reveal is not atomic at the exact threshold
materialChangeTriggers: reference-class fields, broadening order, or minimum sample size changes
probability, uncertainty, or confidence method changes
new data source or evidence-quality tier
aggregation, overlap, or double-counting rule changes
new participant role or lifecycle state
change to eligibility, verified-human, privacy, reveal, withdrawal, or expiry semantics

aggregationPolicy.overlapHandling: A verified resource, action, signer, or deliverable may appear in multiple explanatory views, but may enter an additive platform aggregate at most once. Direct causal attribution and cooperative allocation are alternative attribution lenses and are never summed. Currency, count, duration, and value-adjusted quantities remain separate unless an independently approved immutable conversion snapshot exists.

shapleyPolicy.characteristicFunctionDefinition: For any subset of qualifying signers, coalition value is the number or native-unit quantity of other qualifying participants whose protected public act would be activated and completed by that subset under the frozen threshold, eligibility, deadline, withdrawal, expiry, and completion rules.
shapleyPolicy.approximationMethod: Above 12 participants, use 25,000 deterministic seeded random permutations, publish the Monte Carlo standard error, and withhold the allocation if the error exceeds 5% of the coalition value or if coalition-value monotonicity checks fail.

parameters.publicationRule: withhold modeled components unless exact-hash model approval and current health pass exist
